title: Day convolution
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch9 §4：Segal 对象 X^• 在 IndCoh(X^1) 上给出的卷积幺半结构；§4.4–4.6 的卷积代数即 Day 型卷积幺半范畴中的结合代数对象
definition_zh: Day 卷积是幺半范畴 𝒢 上函子范畴 [𝒢,V] 的典范幺半结构：函子 F、G 的卷积 F∗G 是先取 𝒢 的张量积再沿余端作左 Kan 延拓，即 (F∗G)(c)=colim_{a⊗b→c}F(a)⊗G(b)。当 V=Spc 时它就是群或幺半群上函数卷积的范畴化；它使 [𝒢,V] 成为幺半范畴，单位对象是 𝒢 的单位对象在 Yoneda 嵌入下的像。
key_points: 卷积积由 𝒢 的幺半结构与 V 的余极限、张量交换性共同决定（V 需幺半余完备）
单位对象是 y(1_𝒢)，结合约束与单位约束来自 𝒢 的结合约束和 Yoneda 嵌入
DAG 第 9 章 §4 的卷积幺半结构取在 IndCoh(X^1) 上：Segal 对象 X^• 给出沿 X_1×_{X_0}X_1→X_1 的拉回-推出，正是 Day 型卷积
结合代数对象即卷积代数；它与 Grothendieck 构造/反直化配合，可把函子范畴的幺半结构看成 Hom 函子的拉回
idea_original: The category of functors on a monoidal category canonically inherits itself a monoidal category structure via a categorified convolution product. This holds generally in the context of enriched category theory. This was first observed by (Day 70) and accordingly these monoidal structures are called Day convolution products. In more detail, just as there is convolution of functions f:G→ℂf : G \to \mathbb{C} whenever GG carries the structure of a group, or more generally just the structure of a monoid, so there is convolution of functors f:𝒢→Setf \colon \mathcal{G} \to Set whenever the category 𝒢\mathcal{G} carries the structure of a monoidal category. This may be generalized by replacing Set with a more general cocomplete symmetric monoidal category VV. The technical condition is that VV is a monoidally cocomplete category: i.e. the tensor product u⊗vu \otimes v preserves colimits in its two arguments separately; hence that the functors u⊗−u \otimes - and −⊗v- \otimes v preserve colimits. This occurs notably when VV is symmetric closed monoidal (so that these functors are left adjoints).
references: Geun Bin Im and G. M. Kelly, A universal property of the convolution monoidal structure, J. Pure Appl. Algebra 43 (1986), no. 1, 75-88.
S. R. Johnson, Monoidal Morita equivalence, Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 59.2 (1989): 169-177.
Todd Trimble on Day convolution here
Saul Glasman, Day convolution for infinity-categories (arXiv:1308.4940)
Jay Shah, Parameterized higher category theory II: universal constructions (arXiv:2109.11954)
Vladimir Hinich, Colimits in enriched ∞-categories and Day convolution, Theory and Applications of Categories 39 12 (2023) 365-422 [tac:39-12, arXiv:2101.09538]
Christoph Winges, Hinich’s model for Day convolution revisited, arXiv:2506.06025 (2025).
Brian Day and Ross Street, Lax monoids, pseudo-operads, and convolution, Contemporary Mathematics 318 (2003): 75-96.
our_term: Day 卷积（Day convolution）；卷积幺半结构 = convolution monoidal structure；卷积代数 = convolution algebra
